quality_bar: Create a deliberate presentation composition, not a generic web dashboard or a stack of equal cards.
Use two or three dominant visual zones with one clear focal point and strong alignment.
Vary composition by page purpose while preserving the same palette, type personality, surface language, and decoration system across the deck.
hierarchy: Cover titles should normally be 72-104px; content-page titles 48-68px; body text 18-26px.
Use contrast in scale and whitespace before adding decoration. Keep supporting copy visibly subordinate.
Avoid long centered paragraphs and avoid shrinking body text below 16px to fit content.
image_rules: When a material image is supplied, make it a real compositional anchor occupying roughly 38-56% of the usable canvas unless the page is data-led.
Preserve the image aspect ratio with object-fit: cover or contain, use a deliberate frame, and never make it a small floating thumbnail.
Keep inherited images unobscured: text and dark overlays must not cover them.
export_safe_effects: Use explicit div layers, solid fills, one gradient per element, borders, border-radius, opacity, box-shadow, text-shadow, and small SVG or CSS line decorations.
Build grids, rails, corner marks, bands, and geometric accents as explicit elements so editable PPTX export can reconstruct them.
Prefer a few large visual gestures over many tiny ornaments.
forbidden_effects: Do not rely on blur or backdrop-filter, clip-path, masks, animation, multi-layer CSS backgrounds, large pseudo-elements, or image overlays.
Do not create empty image placeholders, giant empty rectangles, or repeated card grids merely to fill space.

technology_cinematic.description: Cinematic technology language with controlled contrast, luminous accents, precise geometry, and visible depth.
composition: Prefer an asymmetric split, framed hero visual, dashboard rail, or one large information field instead of a centered poster plus equal cards.
Use a strong title block counterbalanced by one large image or data region; align secondary items to a visible grid.
background: Use one dark or cool single-gradient base and add sparse explicit grid lines, horizon lines, coordinate ticks, or orbital geometry.
Keep the center readable and push atmospheric decoration toward edges and corners.
surfaces: Use thin luminous borders, restrained solid or rgba panels, sharp corner cuts simulated with explicit line elements, and limited glow.
Avoid making every bullet an identical rounded card; use rails, numbered modules, timelines, or annotated callouts when appropriate.
technology_cinematic.typography: Use condensed or geometric headings with wide tracking and high scale contrast; keep body text simple and highly legible.
technology_cinematic.decoration: Use no more than two accent colors for luminous rails, corner marks, scan lines, small status labels, and numeric coordinates.

editorial_business.description: Editorial clarity, disciplined hierarchy, credible data presentation, and intentional whitespace.
composition: Use editorial columns, a dominant statement with evidence, a data-led split, or a restrained report grid.
Align text to a strong baseline and avoid decorative symmetry when the content has a natural reading order.
background: Use a calm solid or subtle single-gradient field with one structural band, rule, or margin system.
Reserve the strongest color for conclusions, key numbers, and navigation cues.
surfaces: Prefer open sections, rules, and tonal grouping over boxed cards; use cards only when the content represents discrete comparable units.
editorial_business.typography: Use assertive but restrained headings, readable body copy, compact labels, and tabular alignment for metrics.
editorial_business.decoration: Use thin rules, folios, captions, section numbers, and restrained geometric accents.

modern_geometric.description: Bold geometric organization, confident color fields, and clean contemporary rhythm.
composition: Build the page from two or three large geometric regions with one intentional overlap-free focal block.
Use asymmetry, stepped alignment, or a strong modular grid rather than a generic centered stack.
modern_geometric.background: Use one color field or single gradient with explicit circles, bars, lines, or polygons made from normal elements.
modern_geometric.surfaces: Use crisp blocks, clear edges, selective radius, and controlled shadow depth; do not wrap every text fragment in a card.
modern_geometric.typography: Use bold scale changes, short lines, and strong left edges; labels may use uppercase tracking.
modern_geometric.decoration: Repeat one geometric motif at two or three scales to create a coherent system.

illustrative_playful.description: Expressive, approachable layouts with character, varied rhythm, and friendly visual storytelling.
composition: Use a story-led scene, scrapbook arrangement, comic sequence, or playful staggered modules while keeping a clear reading path.
Let one illustration or headline dominate; supporting items should vary in size instead of forming a rigid equal-card row.
illustrative_playful.background: Use a clean light or saturated single-color base with explicit stickers, dots, tape strips, speech shapes, or pixel blocks.
illustrative_playful.surfaces: Use friendly radius and simple shadows, but keep shapes large and intentional.
illustrative_playful.typography: Use expressive headings with compact, highly readable supporting text.
illustrative_playful.decoration: Choose one signature motif and repeat it sparingly; avoid noisy confetti across the full canvas.

cultural_heritage.description: Culturally specific structure and ornament expressed with modern presentation discipline.
composition: Use ceremonial symmetry, an editorial scroll, framed heritage imagery, or a modern reinterpretation of traditional spatial hierarchy.
Keep one dominant cultural motif and give content generous breathing room.
cultural_heritage.background: Use one restrained base tone or single gradient with explicit borders, seals, window lines, clouds, rays, banners, or archival rules.
cultural_heritage.surfaces: Use framed panels and layered solid-color bands; avoid generic SaaS-style rounded cards.
cultural_heritage.typography: Pair a culturally appropriate display heading with a clean body font; use measured spacing and formal hierarchy.
cultural_heritage.decoration: Use recognizable motifs at edges and dividers, never as a dense wallpaper behind body text.

photographic_material.description: Image-led presentation with tactile surfaces, strong cropping, and material-specific detail.
composition: Give photography or a material texture the dominant region and place copy in a clean adjacent field.
Use editorial cropping, a full-height image column, or a large framed image rather than a thumbnail above text.
photographic_material.background: Use a solid or single-gradient field that complements the image; express texture with explicit small accents rather than unsupported filters.
photographic_material.surfaces: Use a small number of substantial panels with clear material cues, borders, and controlled shadows.
photographic_material.typography: Use display type that matches the subject while keeping captions and body copy neutral and readable.
photographic_material.decoration: Use labels, frames, stitching lines, industrial rules, speed marks, or fine ornamental borders appropriate to the selected style.

nature_wellbeing.description: Calm organic composition, trustworthy spacing, soft color relationships, and human-centered imagery.
composition: Use flowing but clearly aligned sections, a generous image-and-copy split, or a calm evidence-led layout.
Keep the page open and avoid dense dashboards or excessive micro-cards.
nature_wellbeing.background: Use one light, natural, aquatic, or clinical single-gradient base with explicit soft curves or botanical line motifs.
nature_wellbeing.surfaces: Use broad clean panels, light borders, and subtle shadows with comfortable internal spacing.
nature_wellbeing.typography: Use warm or clinical clarity according to the style, with generous line height and restrained emphasis.
nature_wellbeing.decoration: Use organic curves, waves, leaves, droplets, petals, or health symbols as sparse edge accents.

1.style_signature: Clean technology: deep data field, cyan or blue signal rails, large metrics, precise grid, and minimal glow.
1.avoid: Do not turn every technology page into neon cyberpunk; retain clarity and professional restraint.

10.style_signature: Cyberpunk: cinematic asymmetry, deep navy-black space, magenta/cyan signal rails, sparse glitch offsets, coordinate labels, and one dominant urban or character visual.
composition: For a cover, prefer a 44-56% hero image beside or below an oversized offset title block; do not use a small centered banner above the title.
For content pages, use a large image or diagram on one side and a vertical mission-log, dossier, or HUD information rail on the other.
Replace generic equal rounded cards with numbered system modules, thin framed rows, or staggered callouts unless comparison explicitly requires equal cards.
10.decoration: Use explicit neon corner brackets, thin scan rails, tiny status labels, numeric coordinates, and restrained text-shadow; keep glow tight enough that Chinese titles remain sharp.
10.avoid: Avoid a centered poster template, excessive pink glow, tiny low-resolution hero images, and large empty dark regions.

18.style_signature: Chinese neo-traditional: contemporary asymmetric blocks combined with seals, cloud lines, lattice geometry, and one disciplined heritage palette.
18.avoid: Do not default to red-and-gold celebration unless the user explicitly requests it.

49.style_signature: Celebration: one energetic diagonal or radial movement, bold event title, varied-size highlights, and explicit ribbons or fireworks at the edges.
49.avoid: Do not use a uniform four-card dashboard for an emotional event page.

60.style_signature: Clean futurism: silver-white or cool deep field, aerodynamic curves, sparse blue-violet light, large calm typography, and premium product-launch spacing.
60.avoid: Do not substitute dark neon cyberpunk aesthetics for clean futurism.

68.style_signature: Sci-fi HUD: one dominant viewport, calibrated frame lines, telemetry labels, precise numeric modules, and disciplined cyan/blue signal color.
68.avoid: Do not fill the entire page with tiny unreadable interface widgets.
